DIAGNOSIS READY: Unstable Angina.

Your ECG shows ischemia, and your pain pattern matches a cardiac event, but since your troponin levels are unavailable and you are not currently on cardiac medication, we must treat this as an acute coronary syndrome until proven otherwise. Please seek emergency care immediately, as this condition can progress to a heart attack without treatment.
